history.name: WebSurfer
history.content:
Quick reference: Common library status meanings
- Available: On shelves.
- Checked Out: Borrowed, not on shelves.
- On Hold: Pulled or reserved, typically not on shelves.
- In Transit: Moving between locations, not on shelves.
- Processing: In cataloging/repair, not on shelves.
- Lost/Missing: Not available to patrons, not on shelves.
These align with your current interpretation.
